solutions.title: BFS with dictionary scan
solutions.strategy: Run BFS and find neighbors by scanning unvisited words that differ by one character.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each visited word can compare with every dictionary word across l characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue and visited set can store dictionary words.

solutions.title: BFS with wildcard pattern index
solutions.strategy: Index words by wildcard patterns and use those buckets to enumerate one-change neighbors.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of n words contributes l patterns, and pattern string construction costs up to l.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Each word is stored in one bucket per character position.
